technical_and_design_decisions: Implementation will be developed in Go, adhering to standard Hyperledger Fabric config library patterns and idioms.
Protocol Buffer structures (`common.Config`, `common.ConfigGroup`, etc.) will be manipulated through helper methods to encapsulate protobuf parsing.
Capability modifiers will provide explicit toggle helper methods (e.g., enabling/disabling standard Fabric capability versions) while allowing general capability map modifications.
Config retrieval methods (U3, U4, U6) will return structured Go types to prevent callers from needing manual protobuf parsing.
Examples will be implemented as Go `Example...` functions in test files to double as both runnable documentation and automated unit tests.
assumptions: The developer is working within an established Go repository for Fabric channel configuration tools (such as `fabric-config`).
Protobuf definitions and core config update comparison engine (calculating `ConfigUpdate` from original and updated `Config`) are already present in the codebase.
No live Hyperledger Fabric network is required for unit or example tests; testing uses serialized protobuf config fixtures.

activities.activity_description: Analyze existing protobuf structures and define API signatures for orderer endpoint modifiers, capability getters/setters, policy retrievers, and ACL modifiers.
Develop functions to add and remove orderer endpoints from an orderer organization's config group, write unit tests, and verify config update generation.

activities.activity_name: Implement Policy and Application Config Getters (U3, U6)
activities.activity_description: Develop helper functions to retrieve organization policies across Application/Orderer/Consortium orgs and to retrieve Application config structures without manual protobuf parsing.

activities.activity_name: Implement Capabilities Getter and Modifiers (U4, U5)
activities.activity_description: Develop functions to extract channel, orderer, and application capabilities, as well as functions/toggles to add or remove capabilities and compute config updates.
Develop functions to add, update, and remove ACL entries within the Application configuration group and ensure compatibility with the config update flow.
Split the monolithic end-to-end example test into separate, modular example usages focusing on orderer config, application config, org management, MSP modifications, and capabilities.

activities.activity_name: Integration Testing and Code Review Preparation
activities.activity_description: Run total test suite, verify test coverage for all new getters and mutators, perform linting, and update Go documentation.
